Fixes from running get-found against a live Next.js e-commerce site.

- **Fix:** a sitemap root without a trailing slash (`https://site.com`) and the crawled `https://site.com/` were treated as two pages, causing false duplicate-title/description warnings.
- **New:** broken-link (404) warnings now say which pages link to the dead URL.
- **New:** `noindex-summary` shows which sections of the site are `noindex`; `commercial-pages-noindex` warns when product, shop or category pages are hidden from search and AI shopping answers.

Install/upgrade: `/plugin marketplace update get-found` in Claude Code, or download `get-found.zip` below for Claude.ai.

Verified on a live site: perfumeaura.com (137 pages, Next.js 16).
